notes_and_deviations: FDGDD controls: at parent direction the 15 parent fixtures in REVIEW/tz43-fdgdd18-parent-v1/controls (manifest sha256 e05cb4f607f6ee694ccdfa63fde85cd1ef4a5b63678982a941862c40803493aa) were used instead of own mutations; own mutations were built in memory only and never written.

Intended categories are in each parent checker vocabulary; accepted_invariants maps them to the invariant names fixed in the Claude prompt (cases.json mapping_notes). x10_frame_label_mismatch (parent F07) maps to frame.parallel because the prompt vocabulary detects a mislabelled frame class as a class not inside X - (G_x u G_j); c09b (swapped group labels) maps to block.transverse as the parent intended (C06).

mcdsqs-parent-delete-block: the parent fixed-length parser rejected it at the block-list boundary (blocks.length_boundary); this checker reads blocks up to the first POINT line, so the intended mathematical consequence (4 uncovered triples, invariant coverage) is what is accepted here.
gcdcqs-parent-swap-block-points accepts only coverage (not coverage.forbidden) because the parent record shows forbidden_count 0 for that fixture.

mcDSQS fixtures and the comment-free positive are parent-bound projections of the ORIGINAL UTF-8 mcDSQS(74) file (sha256 eaff77fc...16c3), not of the pinned ASCII v2 file; their LF numbers are projection line numbers. The original UTF-8 file itself is rejected as format.encoding (non-ASCII byte 0xe2 at offset 303, comment line 2) under the prompt ASCII-only grammar; this is an informational encoding control, not a mathematical result, and must not be conflated with the ASCII v2 positive.
The prompt grammar is deliberately stricter than lane README section 3 in two places: # is accepted only as a full-line comment, and Format D is accepted only with KIND FDGDD (RDGDD out of scope).

Shared-specification dependency: the definitions, restatement and grammar given to this checker were written by this desk; the Codex route received the same source quotes and README text. Independence is in the implementation, not in the reading of the definitions.
A prompt-only model-written checker plus 108 executions is evidence, not a proof of checker correctness.
